mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.5% indicates a tightening labor market that boosts corporate profits and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in < 40% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST are rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 235), a tightening monetary policy (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1pp in 3 months) compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 235 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1000 thousand units (HOUST > 1000) signals robust residential construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial contraction (INDPRO < 100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to recession risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 16000) and robust housing starts (HOUST > 1000) indicate a healthy economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is < 0.03.
